sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能几乎每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助你理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Israeli airstrike that killed seven aid workers delivering food in Gaza has touched off outrage and condemnations from across the world.
sentences.zh: 以色列的空袭导致七名在加沙分发食物的人道主义救援人员丧生，引发了全球各地的愤怒与谴责。

sentences.en: Today, Kim Severson on the pioneering relief group at the center of the story.
sentences.zh: 今天，金·西弗森将带我们了解事件中心的这个开创性救援组织。

sentences.en: And Adam Rasko on what we're learning about the deadly attack on the group's workers.
sentences.zh: 亚当·拉斯科将为我们讲述目前了解到的针对该组织工作人员的致命袭击情况。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月4日，星期四。

sentences.en: Kim, can you tell us about the World Central Kitchen?
sentences.zh: 金，能给我们讲讲世界中央厨房吗？

sentences.en: World Central Kitchen started as a little idea in Chef Jose André's head.
sentences.zh: 世界中央厨房最初只是主厨何塞·安德烈斯脑海中的一个小想法。

sentences.en: He was in Haiti with some other folks trying to do earthquake relief in 2010.
sentences.zh: 2010年，他和一些其他人在海地试图进行地震救援。

sentences.en: And his idea at that point was to teach Haitians to cook and to use solar stoves and ways for people to feed themselves because the infrastructure was gone.
sentences.zh: 他当时的想法是教海地人做饭，教他们使用太阳灶以及让人类自给自足的方法，因为基础设施已经毁了。

sentences.en: And he was cooking with some Haitians in one of the camps.
sentences.zh: 当时他在其中一个营地里和一些海地人一起做饭。

sentences.en: And they were showing him how to cook beans the Haitian way.
sentences.zh: 他们正在教他如何用海地的方式做豆子。

sentences.en: You sort of smash them and make them a little creamy.
sentences.zh: 你把它们稍微捣碎，做得有点绵密。

sentences.en: And it occurred to him that there was something so comforting for those folks to eat food that was from their culture, that tasted good to them.
sentences.zh: 他突然意识到，对那些人来说，吃到具有他们文化特色、对他们来说美味的食物，是一件极具慰藉的事情。

sentences.en: You know, if you're having a really hard time, what makes you feel good is comfort food, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你正经历非常艰难的时刻，能让你感觉好一点的就是慰藉食物，对吧？

sentences.en: And warm comfort food.
sentences.zh: 而且是温暖的慰藉食物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that moment in the camp really was the seed of this idea.
sentences.zh: 所以营地里的那个时刻确实是这个想法的种子。

sentences.en: It planted this notion in Jose André's mind.
sentences.zh: 它在何塞·安德烈斯的脑海里种下了这个概念。

sentences.en: And that notion eventually became World Central Kitchen.
sentences.zh: 而这个概念最终演变成了世界中央厨房。

sentences.en: And for those who don't know, Kim, who exactly is Chef Jose André?
sentences.zh: 对于不太了解的人，金，主厨何塞·安德烈斯到底是谁？

sentences.en: Jose André is a Spanish chef who cooked under some of the Spanish molecular gastronomy greats, came to America, really made his bones in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 何塞·安德烈斯是一位西班牙厨师，曾师从多位西班牙分子美食大师，后来来到美国，凭借前卫美食在华盛顿特区真正站稳了脚跟，

sentences.en: with some avant-garde food, but also started to expand and cook tapas, cook Mexican food.
sentences.zh: 但他也开始扩展业务，烹饪塔帕斯（西班牙小吃）和墨西哥菜。

sentences.en: He's got about 40 restaurants now.
sentences.zh: 他现在大约有40家餐厅。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, he's got a great Spanish restaurant in New York.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他在纽约有一家很棒的西班牙餐厅。

sentences.en: He's got restaurants in D.C., restaurants in Miami.
sentences.zh: 他在华盛顿特区有餐厅，在迈阿密也有餐厅。

sentences.en: Come with me to the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 跟我来厨房。

sentences.en: Don't be shy.
sentences.zh: 别害羞。

sentences.en: He's also become a big TV personality.
sentences.zh: 他也成了一位知名电视名人。

sentences.en: Chef, are you going to put the lobster in the pot with the potatoes?
sentences.zh: 主厨，你要把龙虾和土豆一起放进锅里吗？

sentences.en: We're going to leave the potatoes and put the potatoes in.
sentences.zh: 我们要把土豆留着，把土豆放进去。

sentences.en: He's one of the most charismatic people I've ever been around in the food world.
sentences.zh: 他是饮食界里我接触过最有个人魅力的人之一。

sentences.en: He's very much the touchstone of what people want their celebrity chefs to be.
sentences.zh: 他非常符合人们对心目中名厨的期望。

sentences.en: So how does he go from being all those things you just described to being on the ground, making local comfort food for Haitians?
sentences.zh: 那他是如何从你刚才描述的那些身份，转变为亲临现场为海地人制作当地慰藉食物的人的呢？

sentences.en: And how does this all go from an idea that that would be a good idea to this much bigger, full-fledged humanitarian organization?
sentences.zh: 这一切又是如何从一个“这会是个好主意”的想法，变成这样一个规模宏大、功能齐全的人道主义组织的？

sentences.en: So he started to realize that giving people food in disaster zones was a thing that was really powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以他开始意识到，在灾区给人们提供食物是一件非常有力量的事情。

sentences.en: He helped feed people after Hurricane Sandy, and he realized that he could get local chefs who all wanted to help and somehow harness that power.
sentences.zh: 他在桑迪飓风后帮助人们分发食物，并意识到他可以召集所有想要帮忙的当地厨师，并以某种方式发挥这股力量。

sentences.en: But the idea really became set when he went to Houston in 2017 to help after Hurricane Harvey.
sentences.zh: 但这个想法在2017年哈维飓风后去休斯敦救援时真正确立了下来。

sentences.en: And that's when he saw that getting local chefs to tap into their resources, borrowing kitchens,
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，他发现通过让当地厨师利用他们的资源、借用厨房、

sentences.en: using ingredients that chefs might have had on hand or, you know, are spoiling in the fridge
sentences.zh: 使用厨师手头可能有的食材，或者冰箱里快要变质的食材——

sentences.en: because the power's out and all these restaurants needed something to do with all this food before it rotted.
sentences.zh: 因为停电了，所有这些餐厅都需要在食物腐烂之前处理掉这些存货。

sentences.en: Harnessing all that and putting it together and giving people well-cooked, delicious, at least as delicious as it can be in a disaster zone.
sentences.zh: 把所有这些力量整合起来，把食物分发给人们，做成烹饪精良、美味可口的食物——至少在灾区能做到的那样美味。

sentences.en: And that's when World Central Kitchen, as we know it today, sort of emerged as a fully formed concept.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我们今天所知道的世界中央厨房作为一个成型的概念浮出水面。

sentences.en: The first pictures now coming in from Puerto Rico after taking a direct hit.
sentences.zh: 现在传来了波多黎各遭到正面袭击后的首批画面。

sentences.en: Hurricane Maria slamming into the island.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚飓风猛烈撞击了该岛。

sentences.en: And as you heard, one official saying the island is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 正如你所听到的，一位官员称该岛已被摧毁。

sentences.en: Shortly after that, he flew to Puerto Rico, where Hurricane Maria had pretty much left the entire island without water and in darkness.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，他飞往波多黎各。当时玛丽亚飓风几乎让整个岛屿断水断电、陷入黑暗。

sentences.en: He flew in on one of the first commercial jets that went back in.
sentences.zh: 他搭乘重返该岛的第一批商业客机之一飞了进去。

sentences.en: He got a couple of his chef buddies whose kitchens were closed and they just decided to start cooking.
sentences.zh: 他找了几个厨房已经关门的厨师朋友，然后他们决定开始做饭。

sentences.en: They were basically just serving pots of stew, chicken stew, in front of the restaurants.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上就是在餐厅门前供应一锅锅的炖菜，鸡肉炖菜。

sentences.en: The lines got longer.
sentences.zh: 队伍越来越长。

sentences.en: And of course, chefs are a really specific kind of creature.
sentences.zh: 当然，厨师是一类非常特别的人。

sentences.en: They really like to help their community.
sentences.zh: 他们真的很喜欢帮助自己的社区。

sentences.en: They're really about feeding people.
sentences.zh: 他们一心想着给人们提供食物。

sentences.en: So all the people who were chefs or cooks on the ground in Puerto Rico who could wanted to help.
sentences.zh: 所以波多黎各当地所有能帮忙的厨师或炊事员都想来帮忙。

sentences.en: And you had all these chefs in the States who wanted to fly down and help if they could too.
sentences.zh: 美国本土也有许多厨师想要飞过去提供力所能及的帮助。

sentences.en: So you had this constant flow of chefs coming in and out.
sentences.zh: 因此，你会看到源源不断的厨师进进出出。

sentences.en: That's when I went down and followed him around for about a week.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我飞了过去，跟在他身边大约一个星期。

sentences.en: And what did you say?
sentences.zh: 你都看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, one of the most striking things was his ability to get food to remote places in ways
sentences.zh: 嗯，最让人震惊的事情之一，是他能够以救世军以及当时在现场的其他政府机构

sentences.en: the Salvation Army couldn't and other government agencies that were on the ground couldn't.
sentences.zh: 无法企及的方式，将食物运送到偏远地区。

sentences.en: You know, the Federal Emergency Management Agency, FEMA, doesn't deliver food.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，联邦紧急事务管理局，也就是FEMA，是不运送食物的。

sentences.en: It contracts with people to deliver food.
sentences.zh: 它是通过合同委托他人运送食物。

sentences.en: So you have all these steps of bureaucracy you have to go through to get those contracts.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须经历层层官僚程序才能拿到那些合同。

sentences.en: And then FEMA says you have to have a bottle of water and this and that in those boxes.
sentences.zh: 然后FEMA会要求你在那些盒子里装上一瓶水以及这样那样的东西。

sentences.en: It's there's a lot of structure to be able to meet the rules and regulations of FEMA.
sentences.zh: 要符合FEMA的规章制度，需要满足很多繁文缛节。

sentences.en: So Jose doesn't really care about rules and regulations very much.
sentences.zh: 所以何塞其实根本不在乎什么规章制度。

sentences.en: So he just got his troops together and figured out where people needed food.
sentences.zh: 他只是把他的队伍聚拢起来，弄清楚哪里的人需要食物。

sentences.en: He had this big paper map he'd carry around and lay out and had a Sharpie in his circle villages where he'd heard people needed food or where a bridge was out.
sentences.zh: 他带着一张巨大的纸质地图到处走，把地图铺开，用马克笔在他听说人们需要食物或者桥梁断裂的村庄周围画圈。

sentences.en: And then he would dispatch people to get the food there.
sentences.zh: 然后他会派人把食物送到那里。

sentences.en: Now, how are you going to do that?
sentences.zh: 那么，你打算怎么做呢？

sentences.en: He was staying in a hotel where some National Guard and military police were staying to go patrol areas to make sure they were safe.
sentences.zh: 他当时住在一个酒店里，一些国民警卫队和宪兵也住在那里，他们要出去巡逻以确保区域安全。

sentences.en: He would tuck his big aluminum pans of food into the back of those guys' cars and say, could you stop and drop these off at this church?
sentences.zh: 他会把装满食物的大铝盘塞进那些人的车后备箱，然后说，你们能顺便在教堂把这些放下吗？

sentences.en: During that time in Puerto Rico, he funded a lot of it off of his own credit cards or with cash.
sentences.zh: 在波多黎各的那段时间里，他很多资金都是靠自己的信用卡或现金支付的。

sentences.en: And then he's on the phone with people like the president of Goya or his golf buddies who are well-connected saying, hey, we need some money.
sentences.zh: 然后他在电话里和戈亚（Goya）公司的总裁或他那些人脉广阔的高尔夫球友沟通，说，嘿，我们需要一些资金。

sentences.en: Can you send some money for this?
sentences.zh: 你能为此寄点钱来吗？

sentences.en: Can you send some money for that?
sentences.zh: 你能为那个寄点钱来吗？

sentences.en: So he just developed this network almost overnight.
sentences.zh: 所以他几乎在一夜之间就建立起了这个网络。

sentences.en: I mean, he is very much a general in the field.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他简直就像是个战场上的将军。

sentences.en: You know, he wears this Orvis fishing vest, has cigars in one pocket, money in the other.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他穿着一件奥维斯（Orvis）钓鱼背心，一个口袋里装着雪茄，另一个口袋里装着钱。

sentences.en: And he just sets out to feed people.
sentences.zh: 他一心只想着给人们提供食物。

sentences.en: And there were deliveries that were as simple as he and a couple of folks taking plastic bags with
sentences.zh: 有些配送非常简单，就是他和几个人拿着装有食物的塑料袋，

sentences.en: food and wading through a flooded parking lot to an apartment building where an older person had
sentences.zh: 蹚过积水的停车场，走到一栋公寓楼前——那里有一位老人已经被困了好几天出不去，

sentences.en: been stuck for a few days and couldn't get out to driving up to a community that had been cut off.
sentences.zh: 而有些配送则是开车前往一个与世隔绝的社区。

sentences.en: There was a church that was trying to distribute food.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个教堂正试图分发食物。

sentences.en: And we drive through this little mountain road and get to this church.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着这条山间小路开车，到达了这个教堂。

sentences.en: We start unloading the food.
sentences.zh: 我们开始卸下食物。

sentences.en: And the congregation is inside the church.
sentences.zh: 会众们都在教堂里面。

sentences.en: Jose comes in.
sentences.zh: 何塞走了进去。

sentences.en: And the pastor thanks him so much.
sentences.zh: 牧师对他的到来连声道谢。

sentences.en: And the 20 people or so who were there gather around Jose.
sentences.zh: 在场的二十来个人围到了何塞身边。

sentences.en: And they begin praying.
sentences.zh: 他们开始祈祷。

sentences.en: And he puts his head down.
sentences.zh: 他低下头。

sentences.en: He's a Catholic.
sentences.zh: 他是个天主教徒。

sentences.en: He's a man who prays.
sentences.zh: 他是一个会祈祷的人。

sentences.en: He puts his head down.
sentences.zh: 他低下头。

sentences.en: He's in the middle of these folks.
sentences.zh: 他身处这些人当中。

sentences.en: And he starts to pray with them.
sentences.zh: 他开始和他们一起祈祷。

sentences.en: And then pulls out his map, circles another spot.
sentences.zh: 然后掏出地图，在另一个地方画了个圈。

sentences.en: And the group is off to the next place.
sentences.zh: 接着这支队伍又出发前往下一个地方。

sentences.en: And when Russia invades Ukraine, he immediately decided it was time for World Central Kitchen to step into a war zone.
sentences.zh: 当俄罗斯入侵乌克兰时，他立即决定是时候让世界中央厨房踏入战区了。

sentences.en: You know, so many people needed to eat.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有太多人需要吃饭。

sentences.en: So many Ukrainians were crossing the border into Poland.
sentences.zh: 许多乌克兰人正在跨越边境进入波兰。

sentences.en: There are refugees in several countries surrounding Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰周边的几个国家都有难民。

sentences.en: So a lot of the work that they did was feeding the refugees.
sentences.zh: 所以他们做的大量工作都是在为难民提供食物。

sentences.en: They set up big operations around train stations, places where refugees were coming.
sentences.zh: 他们在火车站周围以及难民到来的地方建立了大型救助点。

sentences.en: And then they were able to get into cities.
sentences.zh: 随后他们得以进入城市内部。

sentences.en: One of their operations did get hit with some armaments early on.
sentences.zh: 他们的一处救援点在早期确实遭到了武器袭击。

sentences.en: Nobody was hurt badly.
sentences.zh: 没有人严重受伤。

sentences.en: But I think that was the first time that they realized this was an actually more dangerous situation than perhaps going in after there's been an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 但我想那是他们第一次意识到，这实际上比在地震发生后前往救援要危险得多。

sentences.en: But the other thing that really made a difference here is Jose Andres and World Central Kitchen would broadcast on social media live from the kitchens.
sentences.zh: 但这里真正产生影响的另一件事是，何塞·安德烈斯和世界中央厨房会在社交媒体上从厨房进行现场直播。

sentences.en: In the beginning, he'd be holding up his phone and saying, we put out three million meals for the people of Puerto Rico, chefs for Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 一开始，他会举起手机说，我们为波多黎各人民、为波多黎各厨师提供了三百万份饭菜。

sentences.en: It was very infectious.
sentences.zh: 这种精神非常有感染力。

sentences.en: And now one of the standard operating procedures for people who are in the World Central Kitchens is to hold up the phone like that.
sentences.zh: 现在，世界中央厨房成员的标准操作程序之一，就是这样举起手机。

sentences.en: You can see the kitchen busy in the back and talk about how many meals they've served.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到背景中忙碌的厨房，并谈论他们已经提供了多少份饭菜。

sentences.en: You know, they have these kind of wild meal counts, which one presumes are pretty accurate, but they're like, we served 320,000 meals this morning to the people of Lviv.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们有这种惊人的供餐数量，人们推测这些数据相当准确，但他们会说：“今天早上我们为利沃夫人民提供了32万份饭菜。”

sentences.en: I mean, that scale seems important to know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这种规模似乎很重要，需要让人知道。

sentences.en: This is not the kind of work that feeds, you know, a few people in a few towns.
sentences.zh: 这可不是那种只在几个小镇里喂饱几个人的工作。

sentences.en: When you're talking about 300,000 meals in a morning, you're talking about something that
sentences.zh: 当你谈到一个早上提供30万份饭菜时，你谈论的是这样一种规模：

sentences.en: begins, it would seem, to rival the scope and the reach of the groups that we tend to think of as the most important in the disaster relief world.
sentences.zh: 它似乎开始能够与我们在灾害救援界认为最重要的那些团体的规模和影响力相媲美。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And the meals, there are lots and lots and lots of meals, but also World Central Kitchen hires local cooks.
sentences.zh: 而且这些饭菜——有非常非常多的饭菜，但世界中央厨房也会雇佣当地的厨师。

sentences.en: They'll hire food truck operators who obviously have no work and pay them to go out and deliver the meals.
sentences.zh: 他们会雇佣那些显然无工可做的餐车经营者，付钱让他们出去分发饭菜。

sentences.en: They'll pay local cooks to come in and cook.
sentences.zh: 他们会付钱请当地的厨师来做饭。

sentences.en: That's what they do with a lot of their donations, which is very different than other aid organizations.
sentences.zh: 他们用大部分捐款来做这件事，这与其他人道主义组织非常不同。

sentences.en: And this then helps the local economy.
sentences.zh: 而这反过来又帮助了当地经济。

sentences.en: He's trying to buy as much local food as he can.
sentences.zh: 他正试图尽可能多地购买当地的食物。

sentences.en: That keeps the economy going in the time of a disaster.
sentences.zh: 这在灾难时期维持了经济的运转。

sentences.en: So that's a piece of his operation that is a little different than traditional aid operations.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是他运作模式中与传统救援行动有些不同的一部分。

sentences.en: So walk us up to October 7th, when Hamas attacked Israel.
sentences.zh: 那么，把时间推进到10月7日哈马斯袭击以色列的时候。

sentences.en: What does Chef Jose Andres and the World Kitchen do?
sentences.zh: 主厨何塞·安德烈斯和世界中央厨房做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he had had such impact in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他在乌克兰取得了如此巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: And I think the organization itself thought that they had the infrastructure to now take food into another war zone.
sentences.zh: 我想该组织本身也认为他们拥有了将食物带入另一个战区的基础设施。

sentences.en: Gaza, of course, was nothing like Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 当然，加沙和乌克兰完全不同。

sentences.en: But World Central Kitchen shows up.
sentences.zh: 但世界中央厨房站了出来。

sentences.en: They're nimble.
sentences.zh: 他们行事灵活。

sentences.en: They start to connect with local chefs.
sentences.zh: 他们开始与当地厨师建立联系。

sentences.en: Right now, they have about 60 kitchens in the areas around Gaza, and they've hired about
sentences.zh: 目前，他们在加沙周边地区拥有大约60个厨房，并且雇用了大约

sentences.en: 400 Palestinians to help do that.
sentences.zh: 400名巴勒斯坦人来协助开展这项工作。

sentences.en: But getting the food into Gaza became the difficulty.
sentences.zh: 但把食物运进加沙成了难题。

sentences.en: How do you actually get the food into the Gaza Strip?
sentences.zh: 你究竟该如何将食物运进加沙地带？

sentences.en: Large amounts of food that require trucks.
sentences.zh: 大量的食物需要卡车运输。

sentences.en: You've got to realize getting food into Gaza right now requires going through Israeli checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 你必须意识到，现在要把食物运进加沙需要通过以色列的检查站。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that slows the operation down.
sentences.zh: 这拖慢了行动的进度。

sentences.en: You might get eight trucks a day in, and that is such a small amount of food.
sentences.zh: 你一天可能只能开进八辆卡车，这实在是少得可怜的食物。

sentences.en: And this has been incredibly difficult for any aid operations.
sentences.zh: 对于任何援助行动来说，这都极其困难。

sentences.en: So World Central Kitchen, playing on the experience that they had in a war zone and working with
sentences.zh: 因此，世界中央厨房凭借他们在战区积累的经验，以及与

sentences.en: government entities and trying to coordinate permissions, they took that experience from
sentences.zh: 政府实体合作并试图协调通行许可的经验，将他们在

sentences.en: Ukraine and were trying to apply it in the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰获得的经验运用到了加沙地带。

sentences.en: Now, they had worked for a long time with Israeli officials.
sentences.zh: 此前，他们与以色列官员进行了很长时间的合作。

sentences.en: They wanted to make sure that they could get their food in.
sentences.zh: 他们希望确保能够将食物运送进去。

sentences.en: And they decided that the best way to do it would be to take food off of ships, get it in a warehouse, and then get that food into Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们认为最好的方法是将食物从船上卸下，运入仓库，然后再将食物运往加沙。

sentences.en: It took a long time to pull those permissions through, but they were able to get the permissions
sentences.zh: 争取这些通行许可花了很长时间，但他们最终获得了

sentences.en: they needed and set this system up so they could move the food fairly quickly into North Gaza.
sentences.zh: 所需的许可，并建立了这套系统，以便将食物相当迅速地运往加沙北部。

sentences.en: And once they get those permissions, how big a player do they become in Gaza?
sentences.zh: 一旦他们获得这些许可，他们在加沙会成为多么重要的角色？

sentences.en: World Central Kitchen became a kind of a fulcrum point for getting food aid in to Gaza in a
sentences.zh: 世界中央厨房成为了一种枢纽，以一种更大、更成熟的

sentences.en: way that a larger and more established humanitarian aid operations couldn't, in part because they were small and nimble in their way.
sentences.zh: 人道主义援助行动所无法做到的方式，将粮食援助运入加沙，部分原因在于他们规模小且行动灵活。

sentences.en: So the amount of food they were moving maybe wasn't, you know, as large as some of the more established humanitarian aid organizations.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们运送的食物数量可能不像一些更成熟的人道主义援助组织那样庞大。

sentences.en: But they had so much goodwill.
sentences.zh: 但他们赢得了极大的好感。

sentences.en: They had so much logistical knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有丰富的后勤知识。

sentences.en: They were working with local Palestinians who knew the food systems and who understood how to get things in and out.
sentences.zh: 他们与熟悉食品系统、懂得如何将物资运进运出的当地巴勒斯坦人合作。

sentences.en: So they were able to find a way to use a humanitarian corridor to have permissions from the Israeli government to be able to move this food back and forth.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们设法利用人道主义走廊，获得以色列政府的许可，得以在两地之间运送这些食物。

sentences.en: And that's always been the secret to World Central Kitchen is incredibly nimble.
sentences.zh: 这始终是世界中央厨房的秘诀——极其灵活。

sentences.en: So just like in Puerto Rico, they seem to win over just about everybody and do the seemingly impossible.
sentences.zh: 就像在波多黎各一样，他们似乎赢得了几乎所有人的支持，并做成了看似不可能的事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And World Central Kitchen says they delivered 43 million meals to Gazans since the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 世界中央厨房表示，自战争开始以来，他们已向加沙民众分发了4300万份餐食。

sentences.en: And I don't think there was any other group that could have pulled this off.
sentences.zh: 我认为没有其他任何组织能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: And then this caravan, this fairly efficient caravan of armored vehicles labeled with World Central
sentences.zh: 随后，这支车队，这支相当高效的防弹车队，车顶和车身上贴着世界中央

sentences.en: Kitchen logo on the roof, on the sides.
sentences.zh: 厨房的标志。

sentences.en: The idea was they head on this humanitarian corridor, they head on this road.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是走这条人道主义走廊，沿着这条路前进。

sentences.en: The seven people who went all invest, three of whom are security people from
sentences.zh: 前往现场的七人全部遇难，其中三人是来自

sentences.en: Great Britain.
sentences.zh: 英国的安保人员。

sentences.en: You have another World Central Kitchen employee who has handled operations in Asia, in Central America.
sentences.zh: 还有一名世界中央厨房的员工，她曾负责亚洲和中美洲的业务。

sentences.en: She's quite a veteran of the World Central Kitchen operation.
sentences.zh: 她是世界中央厨房行动的资深老兵。

sentences.en: And you have a young man who someone told me was like the Michael Jordan of humanitarian aid, who hooked up with World Central Kitchen in Poland.
sentences.zh: 还有一位年轻人，有人告诉我他就像人道主义援助界的迈克尔·乔丹，在波兰加入了世界中央厨房。

sentences.en: He was a hospitality student and had just become an indispensable, make it happen guy.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名酒店管理专业的学生，刚刚成长为一个不可或缺、能解决问题的人。

sentences.en: And you have a Palestinian guy who's 25, a driver.
sentences.zh: 还有一名25岁的巴勒斯坦司机。

sentences.en: So this is the team.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个团队。

sentences.en: They have all the clearances.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有所有的清关文件。

sentences.en: They have the well-marked vehicles.
sentences.zh: 他们驾驶着标志明显的车辆。

sentences.en: It seemed like a very
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是一个非常

sentences.en: simple, surgical kind of operation.
sentences.zh: 简单、外科手术式的行动。

sentences.en: And of course, now as we know, it was anything but that.
sentences.zh: 当然，正如我们现在所知，事实完全不是这样。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague, Adam Rascon, on what happened to the World Central Kitchen workers
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我的同事亚当·拉斯康（Adam Rascon）将讲述车队中的世界中央厨房

sentences.en: in that caravan.
sentences.zh: 工作人员遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wena Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏编辑，负责编写“拼字联想”（Connections）谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马苏尔斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作“拼字蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母盒”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时，我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的这些人一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: So Adam, what ends up happening to this convoy that our colleague Kim Severson just described from World Central Kitchen?
sentences.zh: 那么亚当，我们的同事金·西弗森（Kim Severson）刚刚描述的世界中央厨房的车队，最终遭遇了什么？

sentences.en: So what we know is that members of the World Central Kitchen had been at a warehouse in Daryl
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，世界中央厨房的成员当时在加沙地带中部代尔巴拉赫

sentences.en: Bella in the central Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: （Dair al-Balah）的一个仓库里。

sentences.en: They had just unloaded about 100 tons of food aid that had been brought via a maritime route to the coast of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚卸下了约100吨通过海上路线运至加沙地带海岸的粮食援助物资。

sentences.en: When they departed the warehouse, they were in three cars.
sentences.zh: 当他们离开仓库时，乘坐了三辆车。

sentences.en: Two of the cars were armored cars, and one was a soft-skinned car, according to the organization.
sentences.zh: 据该组织称，其中两辆是防弹车，一辆是无防护的普通车辆。

sentences.en: When the cars reached the coastal road known as El Rashid Street, they started to make their way south.
sentences.zh: 当车辆到达被称为拉希德街（El Rashid Street）的沿海公路时，它们开始向南行驶。

sentences.en: And what do we know about how much the World Central Kitchen would have told the Israeli military about their plans to be on this road?
sentences.zh: 关于世界中央厨房向以色列军方通报其在这条路上行踪的计划，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the World Central Kitchen said that its movements were coordinated.
sentences.zh: 世界中央厨房表示，其行踪是经过协调的。

sentences.en: And in military speak or in technical speak, people often refer to this as deconfliction.
sentences.zh: 在军方或技术用语中，人们通常称之为冲突降级（deconfliction）。

sentences.en: So basically, this process is something that not only the World Central Kitchen, but the UN,
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这个流程不仅是世界中央厨房，还包括联合国、

sentences.en: telecommunications companies going out to repair, you know, damaged telecommunications infrastructure,
sentences.zh: 前去抢修受损通信基础设施的电信公司

sentences.en: others would use, where they basically provide the Israeli military with information about the people
sentences.zh: 以及其他人会使用的机制，他们基本上会向以色列军方提供关于出行人员的信息、

sentences.en: who are traveling, their ID numbers, their names, the license plate numbers of the cars they'll be traveling in.
sentences.zh: 身份证号、姓名、他们乘坐的汽车的车牌号。

sentences.en: They'll sort of explain, you know, where their destination is.
sentences.zh: 他们会解释自己的目的地在哪里，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And the general process is that the Israelis will then come back to them and say, you're approved to travel from this time, and you can take this specific route.
sentences.zh: 通常的流程是，以色列人会回复他们，说你们被批准在某个时间段出行，并且可以走这条特定的路线。

sentences.en: And do we know if that happened?
sentences.zh: 我们知道这件事发生了吗？

sentences.en: If the IDF said, you're approved, use this route on this night?
sentences.zh: 以色列国防军（IDF）是否说过，你们已获准在当晚使用这条路线？

sentences.en: So we heard from the World Central Kitchen that they did receive this approval.
sentences.zh: 我们从世界中央厨房得知，他们确实收到了这一批准。

sentences.en: The military hasn't come out and said that it wasn't approved.
sentences.zh: 军方并未公开表示未经批准。

sentences.en: So I think it's fair to assume that their movements were coordinated and deconflicted.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为可以合理地推断，他们的行踪是经过协调和冲突降级处理的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what happens as this seemingly pre-approved and coordinated convoy trip is making this leg of the journey?
sentences.zh: 那么，当这个看似获得预先批准和协调的车队在进行这段行程时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: They started to make their way south towards Rafah, and the three cars suddenly came under fire.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向南朝拉法（Rafah）进发，这三辆车突然遭到袭击。

sentences.en: The Israeli army unleashes powerful and devastating strikes on the three cars in the convoy.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队对车队中的三辆车发动了强有力且毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: Most likely from a drone.
sentences.zh: 极可能是来自无人机。

sentences.en: The strikes rip through the cars, killing everyone inside.
sentences.zh: 袭击击穿了车辆，车内人员全部遇难。

sentences.en: Shortly thereafter, ambulances from the Palestine Red Crescent are dispatched to the location, and they retrieve the dead bodies.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，巴勒斯坦红新月会的救护车被派往事发地点，他们找回了遗体。

sentences.en: They bring those bodies to a hospital, and at the hospital, the bodies are laid out, and journalists start to report to the world that indeed five members of
sentences.zh: 他们将这些遗体运送到一家医院，在医院里遗体被摆放好，记者们开始向世界报道，世界中央厨房的

sentences.en: the World Central Kitchen staff have been killed.
sentences.zh: 五名员工确实已经遇难。

sentences.en: And the Palestine Red Crescent teams were continuing the search for other bodies, and eventually brought back two more bodies to the hospital
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦红新月会团队继续搜寻其他遗体，最终又向医院运回了两具遗体，

sentences.en: for a total of seven people killed in these airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 使得在这些空袭中遇难的总人数达到七人。

sentences.en: And when the sun comes up, what does it end up looking like, the scene of these struck trucks from this convoy?
sentences.zh: 当太阳升起时，车队中遭到袭击的卡车现场最终是什么样的？

sentences.en: So early in the morning when the sun comes up, a number of Palestinian journalists headed out to the coastal road and started taking pictures and videos.
sentences.zh: 清晨太阳升起时，许多巴勒斯坦记者前往沿海公路，开始拍摄照片和视频。

sentences.en: And I received a series of videos from one of the reporters that I was in touch with essentially showing three cars, all heavily damaged.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一位与我有联系的记者发来的一系列视频，基本上显示有三辆车，都严重受损。

sentences.en: One had a World Central Kitchen logo on top of it with a gaping hole in the middle of the roof.
sentences.zh: 其中一辆车的车顶上有世界中央厨房的标志，车顶正中间有一个巨大的洞。

sentences.en: A second car was completely charred.
sentences.zh: 第二辆车完全烧焦了。

sentences.en: You could barely recognize the structure of the car.
sentences.zh: 你几乎认不出这辆车的结构。

sentences.en: The inside of it had been completely charred and the front smashed.
sentences.zh: 车内完全烧焦，前部撞毁。

sentences.en: And do we know if the strike on this convoy was the only strike happening in this area?
sentences.zh: 我们知道对这支车队的袭击是该地区发生的唯一袭击吗？

sentences.en: In other words, is it possible this convoy was caught in some kind of a crossfire or in the middle of a firefight?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这支车队有没有可能是卷入了某种交火或激战之中？

sentences.en: Or does it appear that this was quite narrow?
sentences.zh: 或者看起来目标非常明确？

sentences.en: And was the Israeli army targeting these specific vehicles, whether or not they realized who was in it?
sentences.zh: 以色列军队是否在针对这些特定的车辆，无论他们是否意识到车里坐的是谁？

sentences.en: We don't have any other indication that there was another strike on that road around that time.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何其他迹象表明当时那条路上还有其他袭击。

sentences.en: What that suggests, of course, is that this convoy was targeted.
sentences.zh: 当然，这表明这支车队是遭到针对的。

sentences.en: Now, whether Israeli officials knew who was in it, whether they were aid workers, seems like a yet unresolved question.
sentences.zh: 至于以色列官员是否知道车里是谁、他们是否是救援人员，这似乎是一个尚未解决的问题。

sentences.en: But it does feel very clear that the trucks in this convoy were deliberately struck.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，这支车队中的卡车是遭到蓄意袭击的。

sentences.en: Yes, I do think the trucks in this convoy were deliberately struck.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这支车队中的卡车确实是遭到蓄意袭击的。

sentences.en: What is the reaction to these airstrikes on this convoy and to the death of these aid workers?
sentences.zh: 各方对针对这支车队的空袭以及这些救援人员的死亡有何反应？

sentences.en: Well, one of the first reactions is from the World Central Kitchen's founder,
sentences.zh: 嗯，最早做出反应的人之一是世界中央厨房的创始人

sentences.en: Jose Andreas.
sentences.zh: 何塞·安德烈斯（Jose Andreas）。

sentences.en: Chef Jose Andreas, who founded World Central Kitchen, calling them angels.
sentences.zh: 创立世界中央厨房的主厨何塞·安德烈斯称他们为天使。

sentences.en: He said he was heartbroken and grieving.
sentences.zh: 他说他感到心碎和悲痛。

sentences.en: And adding, the Israeli government needs to stop this indiscriminate killing.
sentences.zh: 并补充说，以色列政府需要停止这种无差别的杀戮。

sentences.en: And then he accused Israel of using food as a weapon.
sentences.zh: 然后他指责以色列将食物作为武器。

sentences.en: What I know is that we were targeted deliberately, nonstop, until everybody was dead in this convoy.
sentences.zh: 我所知道的是，我们遭到了蓄意、不间断的针对，直到这个车队里的所有人都死去。

sentences.en: And he just seemed devastated and quite angry.
sentences.zh: 他看起来悲痛欲绝且十分愤怒。

sentences.en: And so what is the reaction from not just World Central Kitchen, but from the rest of the world to this airstrike?
sentences.zh: 不仅是世界中央厨房，世界其他地方对这次空袭有何反应？

sentences.en: There's frankly fury and outrage.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，是愤怒和愤慨。

sentences.en: The White House says it is outraged by an Israeli airstrike that killed seven aid workers in Gaza, including one American.
sentences.zh: 白宫表示，对导致加沙七名救援人员（其中包括一名美国人）丧生的以色列空袭事件感到愤怒。

sentences.en: President Biden, who has been becoming increasingly critical of Israel's approach to this war, he came out and said that he was outraged and heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统对以色列处理这场战争的方式越来越持批评态度，他公开表示自己感到愤怒和心碎。

sentences.en: Certainly sharper in tone than we have heard in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这显然比我们以往听到的语气更严厉。

sentences.en: He says Israel has not done enough to protect aid workers trying to deliver desperately needed help to civilians.
sentences.zh: 他说以色列在保护试图向平民提供急需援助的救援人员方面做得还不够。

sentences.en: Incidents like yesterday's simply should not happen.
sentences.zh: 像昨天这样的事件根本不应该发生。

sentences.en: Israel also has not.
sentences.zh: 以色列也没有做到。

sentences.en: And we're seeing similar outrage from foreign governments.
sentences.zh: 我们看到外国政府也发出了同样的愤怒抗议。

sentences.en: The British Foreign Secretary, David Cameron.
sentences.zh: 英国外交大臣戴维·卡梅伦（David Cameron）。

sentences.en: The dreadful events of the last two days are a moment when we should mourn the loss of these brave humanitarian workers, including...
sentences.zh: 过去两天发生的糟糕事件是一个时刻，我们应当哀悼这些勇敢的人道主义工作者的牺牲，其中包括……

sentences.en: So amid all this, what does Israel have to say about the attack, about how it happened, about why it happened?
sentences.zh: 那么在此背景下，以色列对这次袭击有何说法，关于它是如何发生的，为什么会发生？

sentences.en: The response from Israel this time was much different compared to other controversial airstrikes on the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 以色列这次的回应与以往针对加沙地带具有争议的空袭时的回应大不相同。

sentences.en: Often when we're reporting on these issues, we'll hear from the army that they're investigating a given incident.
sentences.zh: 通常我们在报道这些问题时，会听到军方称他们正在调查某个事件。

sentences.en: It will take days, if not weeks, to receive updates on where that investigation stands.
sentences.zh: 这需要几天甚至几周的时间才能收到有关该调查进展的更新。

sentences.en: There are instances where Israel does take responsibility for harming civilians, but it's often rare.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，以色列确实会为伤害平民承担责任，但这往往很少见。

sentences.en: This time, the Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, comes out with a video message
sentences.zh: 这一次，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）发表视频讲话

sentences.en: saying that Israel had unintentionally harmed innocent civilians.
sentences.zh: 称以色列无意中伤害了无辜平民。

sentences.en: And that was the first indication, or public indication, that Israel was going to take responsibility for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列将对所发生的事情承担责任的第一个迹象，或公开迹象。

sentences.en: The IDF works together closely with the World Central Kitchen and greatly appreciates the important work that they do.
sentences.zh: 以色列国防军与世界中央厨房密切合作，并高度赞赏他们所做的重要工作。

sentences.en: We later heard from the military's chief of staff, Herzl-Levy, issued a video statement in English.
sentences.zh: 我们后来听到军方参谋长赫尔齐·哈勒维（Herzl-Levy）发表了英语视频声明。

sentences.en: I want to be very clear.
sentences.zh: 我想把话说清楚。

sentences.en: The strike was not carried out with the intention of harming WCK aid workers.
sentences.zh: 发动此次袭击并不是为了伤害世界中央厨房的救援人员。

sentences.en: It was a mistake that followed a misidentification.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在识别错误之后发生的错误。

sentences.en: And he said this mistake had come after a misidentification.
sentences.zh: 他说这个错误是在识别错误之后发生的。

sentences.en: He said it was in the middle of a war, in a very complex condition, but...
sentences.zh: 他说这是在战争期间、非常复杂的情况下发生的，但是……

sentences.en: This incident was a grave mistake.
sentences.zh: 这一事件是一个严重的错误。

sentences.en: We are sorry for the unintentional harm to the members of WCK.
sentences.zh: 我们对无意中伤害世界中央厨房成员表示歉意。

sentences.en: He was clear that this shouldn't have happened.
sentences.zh: 他明确表示这种情况本不该发生。

sentences.en: I want to talk about that statement because it seems to suggest that word misidentification, that the Israeli army believed that somebody else was in this convoy,
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈那份声明，因为它似乎暗示了词语误认，也就是以色列军队认为这支车队里有其他人，

sentences.en: that it wasn't a bunch of aid workers.
sentences.zh: 而不是一群人道主义救援人员。

sentences.en: That's possible, although it's extremely vague and cryptic language that genuinely is difficult to understand.
sentences.zh: 这是有可能的，尽管它的措辞极其含糊隐晦，确实很难理解。

sentences.en: And it's a question that us in the Jerusalem Bureau have been asking ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在耶路撒冷分社一直在问自己的一个问题。

sentences.en: I'm curious if the Israeli government has said anything in all of its statements so far about whether it noticed these markings on these three cars in the convoy.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道，以色列政府在其迄今为止的所有声明中，是否曾提及他们是否注意到了车队这三辆车上的这些标志。

sentences.en: Because that, I think, for so many people stands out as making misidentification hard to understand.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为，对很多人来说，这一点让误认变得难以理解。

sentences.en: It seems like perhaps a random pickup truck could be misidentified as perhaps a vehicle being used by a Hamas militant.
sentences.zh: 也许一辆随意的皮卡车会被误认为哈马斯武装人员使用的车辆，这似乎是有可能的。

sentences.en: But a group of World Central Kitchen trucks, with their name all over it, driving down a known aid corridor, that becomes harder to understand as misidentification.
sentences.zh: 但世界中央厨房的一组卡车，车身到处印着他们的名字，行驶在一条已知的救援走廊上，作为误认就更难理解了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's an important question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个重要的问题。

sentences.en: And at this moment, we don't know exactly what the Israeli reconnaissance drones could see and whether or not they were able to see in the darkness of the night
sentences.zh: 目前，我们并不确切知道以色列侦察无人机能看到什么，以及它们是否能够在黑夜中看清

sentences.en: the markings of the World Central Kitchen on the cars.
sentences.zh: 汽车上世界中央厨房的标志。

sentences.en: But what is clear is that when the cars were found in the morning, right there was the big emblazoned logo of the World Central Kitchen.
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，当人们在早晨发现这些车时，世界中央厨房醒目的大标志就在那里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm curious how you think about the speed with which Israel came out and said it was in the wrong here.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你对以色列迅速表态并承认在此事上有错的看法。

sentences.en: Because, as you said, that's not how Israel typically reacts to many of these situations.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所说，这通常不是以色列对许多此类情况的反应方式。

sentences.en: And that makes me think that it might have something to do with the nature of the aid group that was the target of these airstrikes, the World Central Kitchen, and its story.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得，这可能与遭受这些空袭的目标救援组织——世界中央厨房的性质及其背景有关。

sentences.en: I think it does have to do with this particular group.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实与这个特定的组织有关。

sentences.en: This is a group that's led by a celebrity chef, very high profile, who has gone around the world to conflict zones, disaster areas, to provide food aid.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由名人厨师领导、备受瞩目的组织，曾前往世界各地的冲突地区和灾区提供粮食援助。

sentences.en: And I also think it has to do with the people who were killed, most of who were Western foreign aid workers.
sentences.zh: 我也认为这与遇难者有关，他们大多数是西方外国救援人员。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Frankly, I don't think we would be having this conversation if a group of Palestinian aid workers had been killed.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，如果是一群巴勒斯坦救援人员被杀，我认为我们不会在这里进行这场对话。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Nor, perhaps, would you be having the reaction that we have had so far from the Israeli government.
sentences.zh: 也许你也不会对以色列政府迄今为止的反应做出这样的评价。

sentences.en: I would agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我同意这一点。

sentences.en: Adam, at the end of the day, what is going to be the fallout from all of this for the people of Gaza?
sentences.zh: 亚当，归根结底，这一切对加沙人民将产生什么影响？

sentences.en: How do we think that this attack on World Central Kitchen
sentences.zh: 我们认为这次对世界中央厨房的袭击

sentences.en: is going to impact how food, medicine aid is distributed there?
sentences.zh: 将如何影响那里的食物和医药援助的分发？

sentences.en: So, the World Central Kitchen has said that it's suspending its operations across Gaza because it essentially seems that they don't feel they can safely operate there right now.
sentences.zh: 世界中央厨房已经表示，他们正在暂停在整个加沙的行动，因为他们基本上觉得目前无法在那里安全开展工作。

sentences.en: And several ships that carried aid for the organization, which were sort of just on the coast, those ships ended up turning back to Cyprus, carrying more than 200 tons of aid.
sentences.zh: 几艘运载该组织援助物资的船只原本停在海岸附近，这些船只最终调头返回塞浦路斯，船上载有200多吨援助物资。

sentences.en: So, aid that was supposed to reach the people of Gaza is now leaving Gaza because of this attack.
sentences.zh: 因此，本该送达加沙人民手中的援助物资，现在因为这次袭击而正离开加沙。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's also had a chilling effect.
sentences.zh: 而且它也产生了一种寒蝉效应。

sentences.en: Another aid group named Anara has also suspended its operations in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 另一个名为阿纳拉的救援组织也暂停了其在加沙的行动。

sentences.en: And it seems that there is concern among humanitarians that other aid groups could follow.
sentences.zh: 人道主义工作者似乎担心其他救援组织也会效仿。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, in a place where people are already suffering from severe hunger, poor sanitation, the spread of dangerous disease,
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个人们已经饱受严重饥饿、环境卫生恶劣、危险疾病蔓延之苦的地方，

sentences.en: this is only going to make the humanitarian situation, which is already dire, even worse.
sentences.zh: 这只会使本已严峻的人道主义局势雪上加霜。

sentences.en: Well, Adam, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，亚当，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The magnitude 7.4 earthquake that struck Taiwan on Wednesday has killed nine people, injured more than 1,000, and touched off several landslides.
sentences.zh: 周三袭击台湾的7.4级地震已造成9人死亡、1000多人受伤，并引发多起山体滑坡。

sentences.en: It was Taiwan's strongest quake in the past 25 years, but in a blessing for the island's biggest cities,
sentences.zh: 这是台湾25年来最强烈的地震，但幸运的是，对于该岛最大的城市来说，

sentences.en: its epicenter was off the island's east coast, relatively far from population centers like Taipei.
sentences.zh: 其震中位于该岛东海岸，距离台北等人口中心相对较远。

sentences.en: And the first patient to receive a kidney transplanted from a genetically modified pig has fared so well that he was discharged from a Massachusetts hospital on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 首位接受基因改造猪肾移植的患者恢复得非常好，已于周三从马萨诸塞州的一家医院出院，

sentences.en: just two weeks after surgery.
sentences.zh: 距离手术仅仅两周。

sentences.en: Two previous transplants from genetically modified pigs both failed.
sentences.zh: 此前实施的两例来自基因改造猪的移植手术均告失败。

sentences.en: Doctors say the success of the latest surgery represents a major moment in medicine that, if replicated, could usher in a new era of organ transplantation.
sentences.zh: 医生表示，最新手术的成功代表了医学上的一个重要时刻，如果能够复制，可能会开启器官移植的新时代。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Lindsay Garrison,
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由琳赛·加里森（Lindsay Garrison）、

sentences.en: Olivia Natt, and Carlos Prieto, with help from Astha Chaturvedi.
sentences.zh: 奥利维亚·纳特（Olivia Natt）和卡洛斯·普里埃托（Carlos Prieto）制作，阿斯哈·查图维迪（Astha Chaturvedi）提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George, with help from Paige Cowan.
sentences.zh: 节目由马克·乔治（Mark George）剪辑，佩奇·科万（Paige Cowan）提供了帮助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marion Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含马里昂·洛扎诺（Marion Lozano）和丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由旺德利的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰斯伯格（Ben Landsberg）创作。

sentences.en: It for the Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Babaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《裁切机秀》（The Wirecutter Show）将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家一样舒适的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种睡觉需要绝对黑暗的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《裁切机秀》。

sentences.en: The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的《裁切机秀》。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
